name: amiri-finance
description: AMIRI Finance — production-grade financial management / accounting ERP
//engines: Floor set by jsdom 30, which the web test environment needs: on Node 20 its undici fails to define webidl.util.markAsUncloneable and every web suite dies on import. Kept identical to jsdom's own range so the reason stays traceable. .nvmrc pins the major CI and the images build with.

scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && npm run db:up
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @amiri/api" "npm run dev --workspace @amiri/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @amiri/api && npm run build --workspace @amiri/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspace @amiri/api && npm run test --workspace @amiri/web
scripts.test:api: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspace @amiri/api
scripts.test:web: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspace @amiri/web

//overrides: Vitest and the web app both depend on Vite. Two installed copies means two sets of Plugin types, and @vitejs/plugin-react then fails to typecheck against the app's Vite. Pinning one version keeps a single copy hoisted.
